name: pixly
description: Real estate videos from your photos, precise photo edits that keep the rest, floor plans, virtual staging and photo tools.

interface.longDescription:
Pixly makes real estate videos and precise photo edits, right in the chat. Attach a photo of a room, a house or a plot and say what you need. No prompts to write, no video or design software.

VIDEO
- A short property video from one photo, with a real camera move: aerial, orbit, crane, flyover and more
- Flythrough: two to four room photos in walking order become one continuous camera move through the home
- Before-and-after video: an empty room becoming a designed one, a renovation, or day turning into night
- A video that travels from one photo to another

PRECISE EDITS
- Change one thing and keep the rest: recolor the sofa, remove a car, fix the words on a sign, while the rest of the photo is kept as it is
- In Pixly Studio, brush over the exact area to change
- Works on any photo, yours or a Pixly result

EXACT TOOLS
- A clean floor plan from a description or a hand sketch, ready to fine-tune in Pixly's editor
- Before-and-after image: two photos as one comparison, side by side, stacked or split, with labels in your language
- Straighten: leaning walls made vertical and the horizon levelled, automatically
- Watermark: your name or logo on up to ten photos at once
- Blur faces and license plates before a photo goes online

PHOTOS
- Virtual staging and interior design in 61 styles; remove furniture or declutter; restyle walls, floors and cabinets
- Day to dusk, sky replacement, a green lawn, seasonal reset, exterior touch-up and garden makeover
- Furnished or 3D floor plan images from a brochure page or a blueprint
- Plot sign: a 3D SOLD or For Sale sign on a photo of land
- Enhance an amateur shot, and HD upscale up to 4x

GUIDED WORKFLOWS
- Empty room to furnished reveal, walkthrough from room photos, a listing photo kit, listing text and social posts, ready-to-post photos and floor plan to 3D render: ChatGPT runs each with Pixly, step by step
- A whole set of listing photos as one plan, confirmed once
- Listing descriptions and captions written from the finished photos

PIXLY STUDIO
Open Pixly Studio from the sidebar: say what to make from a photo, browse the camera moves as playing examples, start a workflow, and see your photos and videos as a library. Every result shows a before-and-after slider and one-tap next steps, such as turning a staged room into a video.

Results are HD with no watermark, in Pixly's 8 languages. Sign in with your Pixly account to use it.
defaultPrompt: Turn this listing photo into a video with a slow drone move
Make a walkthrough video from these room photos
Change just the sofa in this photo to dark green, keep the rest

positive.description: A short property video from one exterior photo, confirmed in the card before it renders
positive.prompt: Make a short video of this house with a slow drone move.
positive.expected_behavior: The Pixly card shows the settings (drone orbit, 5 seconds, the photo's own shape) and the cost. After tapping the button (or saying yes), the video renders in the card in 2 to 5 minutes and is saved to the Pixly library.

positive.description: Change one thing in a photo and keep the rest
positive.prompt: Make the sofa dark green velvet and keep everything else as it is.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms in the card, the same room comes back with only the sofa changed, shown with a before-and-after slider.

positive.description: Furnish an empty room, then a free before-and-after video in the card
positive.prompt: Furnish this empty living room in Scandinavian style.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms, the furnished room shows in the Pixly card with a before-and-after slider and a button for a free before-and-after video made in the card.

positive.description: A free floor plan from a description, no photo needed
positive.prompt: Draw a floor plan: living room 5 by 4 metres, kitchen 3 by 3 next to it, bedroom 4 by 3, bathroom 2 by 2.
positive.expected_behavior: A clean 2D plan with the rooms, sizes and areas comes back at once; no credits are used.

positive.description: Two listing photos prepared as one plan with one confirmation
positive.prompt: Get these two listing photos ready to publish.
positive.expected_behavior: The Pixly card lists a step per photo (for example a new sky on the exterior, enhance on the bathroom) with each step's cost and one total. After tapping Run the plan, each photo shows in the card as it finishes.

negative.description: Property search is not a Pixly feature
negative.prompt: Find me homes for sale in Austin under $500k.

negative.description: General image generation is not a Pixly feature
negative.prompt: Draw a cat astronaut floating in space.

negative.description: Market or renovation advice is not a Pixly feature
negative.prompt: How much does a kitchen renovation cost and will it raise my home's value?

review.commerce_description: Pixly does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Paid tools use credits from the user's existing Pixly plan; plans are described on pixly.app.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.5.1: every tool now declares all four behavior hints (read-only, destructive, idempotent, open-world) to match what it does; renaming a property folder and changing settings are marked destructive, and the skills no longer report analytics. Version 1.5: two new guided workflows — listing text and social posts (written from the finished photos), and ready-to-post photos (straighten, blur faces and plates, watermark). Pixly Studio's make box takes every photo a tool needs (before and after, 2–4 rooms, start and end) and lists each kind of video on its own. Eight skills.
